Then, they hop on the Big Red Bus with Daddy, moving their hands like wheels going 'round and wipers going 'swish'! The learning continues as they have a musical drumming session with saucepans, play a game of 'What's In The Bag?' and learn about the world around them while singing and dancing.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some gentle lessons and soothing bedtime songs. First, Twinkle learns about the importance of eating healthy, delicious fruit, like bananas, oranges and grapes. Then, help her find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make! After a long day of learning, it's time to get ready for bed. Listen as Twinkle and Mr. Moon sing a soothing nighttime lullaby to help you relax and drift off to sleep.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Go on a magical sky adventure with Twinkle! First, discover the variety of cloud shapes and sizes, from triangles and squares to star-shaped clouds! Then, daydream high in the clouds with Twinkle and Mr. Moon, where her magical stardust makes the moon sneeze and keeps changing colors! The sky-high fun continues as Twinkle soars through the sky on a magical journey to explore all the vibrant colors of the rainbow.

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii and Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii and Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes and Ladders, complete with toy snakes and big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars and a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork and rescue special with Kii and Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii and Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well and needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii and Yii always save the day!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble and other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably and when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Spend a day at home with Cody and his family! Join Cody as he goes to work with his dad, Kwame, at the bakery, where they take on a huge muffin order and deliver them on time. Then, the kids get a special lesson in culture as Kwame introduces them to African instruments like the Balafon and Sangba drum. The day continues with Cody helping his dad cook delicious dishes from Ghana and ends with Mom and Dad comforting him after a bad dream.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for some bath and bedtime fun with Baby John! First, Baby John is a little scared to try swimming, but his family is there to show him just how easy and fun it can be! Then, it's time for a bath. Bathtime has never been so exciting, as Baby John has fun learning his colors by matching different colored bath sharks to their hoops. Finally, it's time to get ready for bed with a fun story and a cozy cuddle.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns what makes his family so special! First, he recounts all the wonderful things about his big sister Jill, from the way they splash in the bathtub to how she takes care of him when he gets a boo boo. Then, he's not interested in spending the day with grandpa, until he sees his vintage motorbike! Together they use their imaginations to take the motorbike through fantastical lands. It's a day of learning how special family is!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues and stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind and has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster and Bubbles builds a rocket to try and reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: It's a day of learning lessons at parties and games! Pogo is invited to Jeff's party, but Pogo wants it to be energetic while Jeff wants it to be calm, so they must learn to compromise. Then, Newt is desperate to win a gold star at Fuse's gym challenges, but she keeps losing! She has to learn to persevere and not give up. The lessons continue as Lulu learns to wait her turn at a funfair and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy greens.

programme.title: The Melon Patch
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers introduce the school bus! With stories and songs, we learn what it is, how it takes kids to school, and its fun features like wheels, wipers, and a horn! Learning is an exciting ride.

programme.title: The Melon Patch
programme.desc: Meet farm animals with Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers! Through stories and songs, learn about cows, horses, sheep, and ducks. Discover where they live and what they eat. Learning is full of moos, quacks, and neighs.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Nature November outings as Baby John meets a new squirrel friend, gets muddy in the backyard, road trips to the mountains, visits an aquarium, explores a Jungle Park, and decorates a farm cow named Lola.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for a fun day at school! First, he learns that karate can be challenging, but with a lot of practice, he learns how to kick, punch and move! Then, he learns how to play soccer with the help of his big brother and sister. The day continues with a special surprise guest who drops in and teaches the gang how to play different instruments, like the piano, trumpet and guitar! It's always a fun day of learning at school!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a sick trick, a spider, a bump and a fly! First, Jeff is sick, but after he recovers, he misses the attention and pretends he's still unwell! Then, Fuse is woken up by spooky noises in the night and must put on a brave face for Lulu to investigate. His bravery is tested again when he finds a spider in his gym and doesn't know how to get it out. The chaos ends when Pogo can't sleep and has to deal with a very noisy fly!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are learning about heroes, sharing, honesty and eating greens! When Lulu loses her favorite bunny, Bubbles comes to the rescue and becomes her personal superhero! Then, Jeff is excited to read a new book but refuses to include his friends, so he must learn the joy of sharing a story. The lessons continue as Pogo accidentally ruins Newt's teddy-shaped hedge and learns to tell the truth, and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy Oddsprouts!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Celebrate family love and healthy habits with JJ! It's JJ's birthday, and his animal friends are setting up a surprise party! Then, learn about eating healthy snacks and veggies with Mommy. The family fun continues with a game of Peekaboo, cleaning up for Valentine's Day and making mashed potatoes together! Plus, say thank you to moms on Mother's Day and watch JJ's parents have a romantic candlelight dinner!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for bedtime stories and daily routines! Mommy sings a lullaby when JJ doesn't want to sleep, and Ms. Appleberry leads the first nap time at school. Then, walk Bingo around the neighborhood as everyone greets JJ! The routine fun continues as the family builds JJ's first big boy bed together and has a fun mother-daughter day. Plus, Mommy and Daddy sneak into the kitchen for a late-night snack!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate outdoor play day! Mummy and Daddy take the kids to the park to fly colorful Japanese koinobori kites. Then, Mia and Max head to the pond to feed the ducks, but are shocked to find there are no ducks there! They must go on an adventure to find them. The outdoor fun continues as Mummy sets up a painting session in the park, where the kids have fun discovering new colors with their fingers, hands and feet!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of imagination and play with Mia and Max! First, they decide to let their imagination run free and build a big dollhouse, but Max has more fun pretending to be a dinosaur that knocks it down! Then, Daddy and Twinkle show the kids how much fun can be had with shadow puppets, making all sorts of different animal shapes. The imaginative fun continues as they turn five empty green bottles into fuzzy-armed monsters that Twinkle brings to life!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage Classics
programme.desc: Sort spare parts with Florence the Forklift, fix Dylan the Dump Truck at the construction site, dig a garage surprise with Danny, count to ten as Max jumps ten trucks, and enjoy colorful ice cream treats with Vicky.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage Classics
programme.desc: Watch Super Mechanical rescue stuck Tony the Taxi, help Andy the Animal Ambulance reach Dr Poppy's clinic, save Rick the Road Roller with Helen, learn the alphabet with the Mechanicals, and transform rusty Oscar into a shiny tour bus.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo and his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie and tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo and takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house and needs to be stopped!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Groove into Nature November as JJ, YoYo, TomTom, Cody and Nina dance with farm animals, wake sleepy bunnies, sing to sheep, and boogie with cows, pigs and chickens on the farm dance stage.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Explore the outdoors this Nature November as JJ finds his teddy in the forest, camps in the backyard through rain, grows a garden with Ms. Appleberry, harvests vegetables, and meets a friendly spider on a picnic.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big family adventures! First, the family goes on vacation and experiences the excitement of taking a plane for the first time, while also learning some good manners. Then, they are off to the aquarium to see all kinds of sea creatures, like seahorses, jellyfish and an octopus! The adventures continue with a trip to the jungle park to see birds and monkeys, and a super fun day at the fair!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Celebrate Nature November as Baby John explores the zoo, chases an escaped sheep on the farm, splashes at the water park, warms up with family exercise, and builds a sandcastle at the beach.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as his amazing dreams come to life! First, he dreams he is a fish, complete with a tail and fins! He's scared when he meets a big shark, but soon learns the shark just wants a friend to play with. Then, it's all stations go as Buster dreams he's a space rocket and blasts off to tour all the planets! The dreams continue as he becomes Sheriff Buster in the wild west and finds a magic spell book that causes all sorts of trouble!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Watch as Buster becomes a real-life superhero! When a storm starts during a nature walk, everyone panics, but it's up to brave Buster to lead them all safely home through the rain and wind. Then, Buster wants to be an emergency vehicle. He gets his chance to be a hero when he's guarding the fire station and a fire breaks out! It's up to Buster the hero fire truck to save the day. From flying like Super Buster to rescuing a kitten, he's always a hero!

programme.title: Morphle Classics
programme.desc: Become Morphles for a chaotic helicopter crash, chase a dinosaur-loving Troy across town, tell a rainy-day story with a morph-off, star as Morphle in a school play, rescue a beached shark, and solve a mystery as kid detectives.

programme.title: Morphle Classics
programme.desc: Return missing objects through time portals with mischievous Orphle in tow, outsmart Orphle in a race-car game of tag, team up to stop the Bandits, prank grumpy Mr. Vanderboos, rescue waterslide tickets, and enjoy a desert water fight.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel finds the remote to control Arpo, turning the robot babysitter into everything from an elephant to a bird! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray and has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Nature November fun as Cody eats pretend dinosaur snacks, tames a windy pinwheel, rescues stuffed sheep, plays in autumn leaves, meets a lost duckling, hikes with Dad, builds sandcastles, and digs in the garden.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody for some big moments! Go to work with Dad at the bakery, find out you're going to be a big brother, and form a rock band with your friends. Go on a safari for dinosaurs and celebrate a special Dino Birthday!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Have a calming and magical night with Twinkle the star! When Bao Bao struggles to sleep, Twinkle arrives and transforms into a hot air balloon to lift her cot into the night sky so she can see the moon. Then, she helps Max, Muffin and Bao Bao get ready for bed by transforming into a cuddly teddy bear to give them all warm goodnight hugs. From creating a magical rainbow over the bath to turning into a kite for a gentle ride, Twinkle always makes bedtime magical.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join the kids for a day of food, play and learning! First, Grandma Panda bakes some cupcakes while Mia and Bari role-play as bakers in their own pretend kitchen and play a game of pat-a-cake. Then, it's time for a teddy bear's picnic with a whole variety of different tasty treats! The learning continues as Daddy and Twinkle show Max how to say hello with a wave before going into town to wave hello to all their friends. It's a fun-filled, yummy day!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of discovery and play with Twinkle and her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax and Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions and see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror and make funny faces and wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some gentle lessons and soothing bedtime songs. First, Twinkle learns about the importance of eating healthy, delicious fruit, like bananas, oranges and grapes. Then, help her find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make! After a long day of learning, it's time to get ready for bed. Listen as Twinkle and Mr. Moon sing a soothing nighttime lullaby to help you relax and drift off to sleep.

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath and watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Join Kii and Yii for songs about feeling good and staying safe! First, learn the best way to get a healthy smile in a fun and educational song about how to brush your teeth properly. Then, learn how to be safe when you're riding a bike at the playground. The lessons continue as Kii and Yii sing about being kind to each other, especially when a friend is sick. From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!

programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: Scruffts

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her "experiences in ruling over dozens of cats", which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.desc: Talented tabbies, mischievous moggies and fabulous feline fails - they're all here, plus we're catching up with the stars of some of the web's most popular cat videos.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Have A Pet Day

The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: (DL) TVS Highlight
programme.desc: TVS Highlight showcases the most current and important news in a compact, well-rounded format, featuring both local and international updates with thorough and succinct reporting.

programme.title: Crawling
programme.desc: Mengisahkan 4 remaja dilahirkan dan membesar disekitar Bandar Metropolitan dalam keluarga yang berbeza latarbelakang ekonomi, ada yang hidup mewah,ada yang dicemari dengan budaya yang tidak sihat.

programme.title: (DL) TVS Ringkas

programme.title: TVS Fillers

programme.title: Borneo Wildlife & Nature

programme.title: Sarawak Women in History
programme.desc: Explore the lives of loud women who stood up for Sarawak, breaking barriers, social stigmas and creating history. This documentary, we celebrate and appreciate the reverberation of their voice to this day

programme.title: (L) Berita Wilayah TVS

programme.title: Headgear Hunting

programme.title: Kamek, Ali Wallace
programme.desc: Alfred Russel Wallace's study in Southeast Asia relied on Ali, a Malay teen from Sarawak, who helped collect 125,660 specimens over 8 years, contributing to The Malay Archipelago and global recognition.

programme.title: Border Towns of Sarawak
programme.desc: Documentary filmmaker Yusmal Ghazali explores borderlands, immersing in local life, meeting officials, villagers, entrepreneurs. Revealing history, traits, economy, tourism, post-pandemic challenges.

programme.title: (L) Berita Iban TVS
programme.desc: Berita Iban memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Iban

programme.title: (DL) Menarik Sepuluh

programme.title: (L) UTAMA 740
programme.desc: UTAMA 740 memaparkan berita terkini yang menyeluruh dan padat dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: (DL) Detik Dunia
programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: Gerak Khas 2.0

programme.title: Boneka
programme.desc: Demi mengejar kehidupan sempurna, pengkhianatan seorang wanita terhadap suami yang pernah menyelamatkannya bermula apabila dia hanyut dalam godaan cinta dan kemewahan lelaki lain.

programme.title: (L) TVS Nightline

programme.title: The Cube

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Born out of wedlock,a beautiful young lady,Mikayla works as a makeup artist who struggles to be acknowledged by her biological mom.She chose to embark on a new journey finding self-worth deserving love.

programme.title: Barbarossa
programme.desc: Sultan's Order historical drama about Barbaros Hayreddin,appointed as Captain by Sultan Suleyman the Magnificent,who turns the Mediterranean into a Turkish lake and founds the secret organization ITIMAT.

programme.title: Headgear Hunting

programme.title: Unearth Sarawak: Indigenous Cuisines
programme.desc: Showcases iconic and forgotten cuisines from Bidayuh, Melanau, Chinese, Iban, and Orang Ulu ethnics, aiming to preserve heritage cuisines, boost local communities, and promote gastronomy tourism.

programme.title: Pejalai Kamek Orang

programme.title: Ride Your Story

programme.title: The Food That Binds the Nation

programme.title: Jelu Siga

programme.title: Journey of the Bidayuh

programme.title: Stories in Motion

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E78
programme.desc: Al entrar en la mansión Santa María con sus maletas, Clara se encuentra con Raúl, a quien recibe amorosa. Clara lo besa enamorada aunque Raúl se contiene.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E027
programme.desc: Hilario de forma astuta maneja la situación frente a Leopoldo y los policías que lo acompañan, de tal manera que Monteverde queda como único indiciado en el secuestro de Fernanda. Victoria asegura que va a demostrarle a Nicolás que está equivocado sobre Hilario, pero él le indica que no es así, pues a Guanipa lo encontraron en el lugar donde tenía secuestrada a Fernanda aunque él supo librarse de lo ocurrido; la pareja acuerda defender su amor y tratar de superar lo que los separa. Hilario se presenta en casa de Carmencita a conversar con Victoria pero, en vista de que no está, decide aprovechar la oportunidad para explicarle a Adelaida que él la ama a pesar de tener otras mujeres.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E028
programme.desc: Adelaida se molesta con Hilario porque el hombre se niega a darle explicaciones sobre su problema con Nicolás; la señora se marcha furiosa; mientras que, los hombres se quedan discutiendo porque Del Casal advierte a Guanipa que no piensa permitir que intervenga en su relación con Victoria. Felipe, con el periódico donde apareció la noticia del matrimonio en la mano, se presenta en casa de los Alcoy a pedirle a Antonieta que detenga la farsa de su boda. Victoria nada desnuda en el río de Cantarrana cuando descubre a Nicolás observándola embelesado; el joven, que explica cómo llegó tan rápido hasta ahí, se sorprende cuando su amada comienza a lanzarle piedras a la vez que le exige que se retire cuanto antes del lugar.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E05
programme.desc: Ignacio asume que se convertirá en socio del Da Perroni aunque Salvatore tiene la sensación de que cometió un gran error al aceptar la ayuda de su yerno.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E06
programme.desc: Una decidida Adriana amenaza con gritar si Carlos Raúl no la suelta; éste sella sus labios con un inesperado beso.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E013 - Episode 13
programme.desc: Cheíto no soporta las ofensas de Juan Carlos hacia Abigail y se pelean. Carlos Alfredo lo expulsa. Guillermo sorprende a Cheíto en el jardín y Abigail le confiesa que es su hijo. Carlos le pregunta a Abigail con quién se quedará ahora que se divorcien.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E014 - Episode 14
programme.desc: Carlota le confiesa a Abigail que fue ella quien dijo todas las mentiras sobre Cheíto y ella para no perderlo. La conversación la escucha Berta y después le pide perdón. Mariana se pone mal y pide ver a Cheíto. Carlos Alfredo trata de impedir que la vea.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E23
programme.desc: Gertrudis recuerda a Claudio la conveniencia de mantener su relación oculta para no levantar sospechas, pero viviendo la libertad de su amor. Guillermo una vez más lanza una sentencia de muerte sobre Alberto, si a Lorena se le ocurre dejarlo por él - Alberto se presenta en casa de Lorena, con la excusa de saber cómo sigue Ignacio; ella se aterra pues recuerda la amenaza de Guillermo, le dice que no es una buena idea que él esté allí, pero Alberto enamorado le contesta que no puede, no quiere, ni piensa irse de su vida.

Florencia le hace creer a Hilario que él tenía razón al advertirla sobre los Alcoy, pues descubrió que ellos están dispuestos a hacer hasta lo peor por recuperar Cantarrana. programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E031
programme.desc: Victoria trata de hacerle entender a Hilario que ella y Nicolás se aman sin importarle los odios del pasado entre su familia. Isaura y Carmencita están decididas a buscar la manera de convencer a Adelaida de que el verdadero Hilario no es el que le escribe las cartas. Yosmir le hace creer a Isaura que está saliendo con la hija del dueño de la carnicería para conseguir que la señora le preste dinero. Victoria asegura a Nicolás que no volverá a creer en sus mentiras, pues ya leyó todos sus correos y descubrió su plan; él aunque no entiende de qué le habla, le ruega que no se deje engañar por Hilario y sigan adelante con su idea de casarse; ella decide quemar Los Samanes e insta a Nicolás a marcharse de Cantarrana en la avioneta que le tiene preparada, pues ella está decidida a matar el amor que siente por él para siempre. Adelaida admite ante Carmencita que debe reconocer que Hilario nunca va a dejar de hacerla sufrir, pero ella tampoco va a dejar de amarlo.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E032
programme.desc: Aunque Victoria quiere que Hilario se olvide de Nicolás de una vez; el señor Guanipa está seguro de que llegará el día en que ella misma le pedirá que le cobre a Del Casal lo que le hizo, pues no va a poder vivir con tanta rabia. Fernanda se molesta al saber que Nicolás estuvo en Cantarrana. Nicolás comenta con Florencia que está seguro de que Fernanda se las ingenió para mandar desde su computadora un montón de cartas que le hicieron creer a Victoria que él la ha estado engañando; el joven está convencido de que la joven Zapata no es quien está ayudando a su tía y duda que haya sido Hilario quien contratara a alguien que lo hiciera como ella sugiere. Nicolás le cuenta a Fernanda de los papeles que encontró en Los Samanes; el joven asevera que, aunque Victoria los destruyó, él recuerda varios nombres y piensa que con eso, y lo que Rosendo le contara a Florencia, pueden empezar a buscar pruebas en contra de Guanipa.

Hilario quiere desaparecer a Nicolás, pero Victoria no quiere tragedias, sino arruinar al joven Del Casal y toda su familia. Adelaida relee las supuestas cartas de Hilario, pero las esconde cuando el hombre llega a su lado; la señora acepta las caricias de su esposo aunque se siente muy confundida por lo que acaba de descubrir. A Felipe le extraña cuando Hansen le ordena que prepare una carpeta con todos los negocios que tienen en Cantarrana, pues debe viajar de inmediato para la hacienda. La sorpresa se apodera de Clementina cuando Antonieta la busca para decirle que no se pude casar con Felipe.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E034
programme.desc: Adelaida aclara a Hansen que regresó con Hilario porque así lo decidió; el hombre sospecha que ella sabe lo qué fue a decirle, sobre todo cuando ella asegura que no verlo hubiera sido un alivio para ella. Victoria termina aceptando el reto de Jack y se lanza en parapente con él. Felipe acuerda con Clementina ir a una fiesta; la muchacha sugiere a Victoria que también vaya, pero acompañada de Jack Builder para que Nicolás se muera de los celos. Eugenia se disculpa con Yosmir por la forma en que lo trató frente a sus amigas y le explica sus motivos; el jovencito considera que si para ella es tan complicado estar con él debería pensarlo mejor. Hilario no quiere darle información a Florencia sobre el "negro Quijada", pero la muchacha le asegura que su intención es sólo pedirle disculpas al familia del hombre como Rosendo le encomendó.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E01 - The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska. It’s here where a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat these fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E02 - Fish Like A Bear
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mom and her three cubs. They arrive at their destination and see many bears that they have already met as well as some new faces.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E03 - A Working Ecosystem
programme.desc: Everyone hates biting insects, but if you look closer you can see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem. During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E04 - The Wolf and the Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot where a large number of bears have gathered.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris and Casey have hiked across New Zealand for weeks. Fighting for their lives has taken a toll on their emotions and abilities. They team up to hunt feral pigs, but the cache items used for survival create new challenges and deep frustrations.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E13 - Lost Gill Net

programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E01 - The Mission
programme.desc: The United States and China are considering launching manned missions to Mars -- in 25 years. But Netherlands-based Mars One has a bold plan to land humans on Mars in 2027. Is the mission fueled by wishful thinking and unproven science -- or will private exploration get us there?

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E03 - The Journey
programme.desc: The trek from earth to Mars is fraught with difficulties, from surviving radiation en route to landing in a space craft not yet designed. programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E04 - Surviving on Mars

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E05 - Why One Way
programme.desc: Mars One plans one-way missions to Mars; the goal is not simply to explore, but to colonize the red planet. A one-way trip saves billions and eliminates the risk of a return voyage. programme.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean!

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E01 - Opportunity A Life On Mars
programme.desc: In 2019 we said goodbye to one of our most intrepid planetary explorers, the Opportunity rover. Take a look back at its storied 15-year mission on Mars, and how it revolutionized our understanding of not just the red planet, but our solar system at large.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E10 - The Sound Of Science
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds.Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they tune into the science behind sound. This week’s experiments hit high notes as we discover the physics of theremins, investigate how the outer ear impacts human hearing, and put on a laser show with cymatics.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E09 - Don't Believe Your Eyes
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they make science look like sorcery. This week’s experiments delve into the possibilities of mind control, why objects and people tend to sync together, and the magical mysteries behind magnesium.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E06 - Hot Hot Heat
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they turn up the thermostat and discover the role heat plays in science. This week’s experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E05 - Up and Atom
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they break open the atomic bonds that connect our world. This week’s experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E33 - Nicola Adams, Refugee Olympic Team, and Abebe Bikila
programme.desc: Nicola Adams became the first woman to win Olympic boxing gold, and then the first woman to do it twice, the Refugee Olympic Team escaped war and social disintegration to fulfill their dream of competing at the Olympics, and Abebe Bikila shocked the world by winning marathon gold and breaking the world record in 1960 without shoes.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E28 - Tyson Fury, Randy Turpin, Claressa Shields
programme.desc: Tyson Fury defeated two of the scariest boxers in history and his own inner demons to become the heavyweight champion of the world - twice. Randy Turpin overcame the greatest boxer of all time at the height of his powers and Claressa Shields persevered through the most violent city in America to shough female boxers a new definition of success.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E29 - Magic Johnson, Becky Hammon, Yao Ming
programme.desc: Magic Johnson proved to everyone that HIV wasn’t a death sentence by flourishing in his post-playing career. Becky Hammon was told the most she could hope for was a college scholarship, so she became the first female coach in the NBA, and Yao Ming silenced his critics by becoming the most popular NBA player in the world.

While the World Cup is revered by all who grace its stage, France self-destructed in 2010 in a manner unimaginable. And while he may have never won a World Cup, Chile’s Claudio Bravo made his nation proud on the Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola
programme.desc: The quiet, unassuming character of Germany’s Philipp Lahm - one of the best Germany has seen. The 1998 World Cup in France - one with some of the best storylines. Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.

programme.title: Light The Dark
programme.desc: A pipeline explosion tears Chen Shan's family apart. Wrongfully jailed, he returns years later to uncover the truth, but his brother-in-law hides dark secrets and a greater danger looms.

programme.title: Awfully Lawful
programme.desc: This drama depicts the challenges faced by four high-profile lawyers in their 40s. Will they cave, or grow from these midlife crises?

programme.title: E.U.
programme.desc: This much-awaited sequel to the popular police drama revolves around an elite unit of cops as they take on the most notorious triads in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The White Castle
programme.desc: A brilliant medical doctorate joins the Emergency Department and must prove himself amid fierce competition, a demanding mentor, and life-or-death challenges.

programme.title: Archives: The Nanyang Mystery
programme.desc: Adapted from a suspense novel. In early Nanyang, bizarre cases unfold as two Southern Archives agents assigned to investigate uncover a deadly conspiracy, with all clues pointing to a mysterious ship.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right.

programme.title: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: Featuring three stories about two high school friends, a magician and a lost man, the movie reveals the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: Plotting to seize a massive inheritance from a dying tycoon, a mercenary 'relativei hires Tricky Star to steal the will in order to alter it.

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Iceman The Time Traveller
programme.desc: Defrosted in modern Hong Kong, four imperial guards return in pursuit of the Golden Wheel of Time. As Ying seeks to rewrite the past, he unknowingly steps into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, uncovering its atrocities and risking their lives to expose the truth.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey Part II - A Cinderella
programme.desc: After Joker (Stephen Chow) goes back 500 years, he runs into myriad oddball characters, including the Longevity Monk.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set against four different eras, this 4-part anthology directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng & Shen Teng depicts how China's forefathers fought to defend the nation & family honour.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer & pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a novel of the same name by Erica Li, an urban sketcher suffering from ALS asks his crush to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day.

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: The Panda Plan: Magical Tribe
programme.desc: Superstar Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu are ambushed by robbers during their journey. In the chaos, they plunge off a cliff and discover a mysterious, isolated tribe hidden from the outside world.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Legend of the Fist:The Return of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: As Japan's grip on China tightens, Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai to infiltrate the notorious Club Casablanca, whose owner is a Japanese collaborator.

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: The death of a charity's CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charity's darkest secrets and seek justice.

programme.title: She's Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks "Jiang Yuan Nong" when the frail Zhan Zhou Shi kills and dismembers her husband. As dark truths emerge, the fate of everyone involved begins to twist.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue & Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Ordinary girl Bao meets troubled rich guy Edward. They conspire to ruin his father's remarriage and love blossoms. However, their romance takes an unexpected turn...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: Powerful, insane and obsessed with hatred, the bride with white hair has gone on a killing rampage, and can only be stopped by the one person she loves.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of a deserted mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must battle the zombies as the mall descends into hell.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: Inspector Yan's daughter is found dead, and her classmate Wen is arrested. However, when another killing occurs after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect that the true killer is still at large.

programme.title: Lelio Popo
programme.desc: Famous radio DJs Jiang Man Da and Lu Ye Chang are fired and blacklisted. To make a comeback, they disguise themselves as elderly women to host a new radio show sparking unexpected success and comedy.

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammer's clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with a mysterious detective while probing bizarre cases. From distrust to fate-bound allies, they join forces against a dark threat looming over the city.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the exam. When an accident changes everything tragically, Zhang travels back in time. Can he amend things this time?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who can enter a person's subconscious. As she investigates a murder-cum-suicide case, she finds herself under suspicion and comes face-to-face with a past trauma...

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Buil
programme.desc: Detective Dee investigates a series of strange incidents at Tang's building, finding the master suspicious when even his eldest daughter secretly tells Dee of his odd behavior.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: This in-depth analytic news bulletin reports on major news events around the world from an unbiased perspective.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Hosted by Bob Lam, Jonathan Wong, Oscar Leung, Penny Chan and Ricky Fan, each episode brings fun and relaxed interviews with stars and icons from all walks of life!

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
